annotations.title: Get a fare and payment quote

description: Quote a trip using the website fare. fare_cents is the price the user pays. Provide flight details or acknowledge when they are unknown for an airport pickup. Some trips are request-only. Fares are subject to availability. For a typed address, the passenger enters the address on the site. For a Sprinter hourly trip, the passenger selects the duration on the site.

date.description: Pickup date in Miami, YYYY-MM-DD. For packages use legs.

escalade.description: Request the Cadillac Escalade upgrade where offered, subject to availability.

flight.description: Arrival flight number for an airport pickup.

flightUnknown.description: True if the rider does not have the airport pickup flight information.

from.description: Pickup location ID, or other for a typed address.

fromText.description: Pickup address when from is other.

hotelText.description: Hotel name or address for a cruise package with a hotel stop.

hours.description: Choose a whole number of hours from 2 to 12 for Suburban hourly and 3 to 12 for Sprinter hourly.

legs.description: Pickup dates and times in the cruise package's leg order.

date.description: Leg pickup date in Miami, YYYY-MM-DD.

time.description: Leg pickup time in Miami, HH:MM.

meetAndGreet.description: Request paid baggage-claim meet and greet for an airport pickup. Requires its flight number.

passengers.description: Passenger count, including children. Defaults to one.

returnTrip.description: Return leg for a point-to-point round trip.

date.description: Return pickup date in Miami, YYYY-MM-DD.

flightHome.description: Departure flight number after the return drop-off.

returnFlight.description: Arrival flight number for an airport return pickup.

returnFlightAirline.description: Airline for the return pickup flight.

returnFlightUnknown.description: True if the rider does not have the return pickup flight information.

time.description: Return pickup time in Miami, HH:MM.

to.description: Return destination ID. Return pickup is the outbound drop-off.

sprinterMode.description: Sprinter request mode. Omit for hourly.

time.description: Pickup time in Miami, HH:MM in 24-hour time. For packages use legs.

to.description: Drop-off location ID, or other for a typed address.

toText.description: Drop-off address when to is other, or stops for hourly Sprinter.

name: get_quote
title: Get a fare and payment quote
